items.title: Reorder dirty classifier so declared artifacts cannot override material/fixture/config
items.context: dirty-worktree.ts classifyParsedRow currently checks isDeclaredArtifactPath BEFORE isFixturePath and isMaterialSourcePath. Move the declared check to AFTER material/fixture so a declared path can only rescue rows that would otherwise be unexpected_dirty_files — never reclassify a blocking material_source_changes or fixture_changes row. This is the hard gate against the CRITICAL bypass.
items.userSees: When a source file (e.g. packages/main/src/core/store.ts) is dirty and has been declared as an artifact, koala validate / koala session_brief classification output still groups it under `material_source_changes` (blocking) — NOT `declared_artifact_changes`. A declared path under tests/output/ that would otherwise be unexpected is still rescued to `declared_artifact_changes`.

happy.desc: After classifier reorder, a dirty path declared as artifact that lives under tests/output/ classifies as declared_artifact_changes (rescue from unexpected still works)

edge.desc: A dirty source file declared as artifact classifies as material_source_changes (declared check runs after material)
A dirty fixture file declared as artifact classifies as fixture_changes (declared check runs after fixture)

adversarial.desc: A hand-injected declared-artifacts.json entry pointing at a source path does NOT bypass the gate — classifier still returns material_source_changes (hard gate independent of artifact_declare entry path)

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke assertDeclaredArtifactGateHotfix: a dirty tests/output/ path declared as artifact still classifies as declared_artifact_changes (rescue from unexpected preserved after reorder)

Smoke: dirty fixture file declared as artifact classifies as fixture_changes (declared check runs after fixture)
Smoke: hand-injected declared-artifacts.json with a source path does NOT bypass — classifyParsedRow still returns material_source_changes (classifier hard gate independent of artifact_declare)

items.title: Reject material/fixture/config/metadata paths at artifact_declare entry
items.context: artifact_declare assertSafePath only blocks glob/absolute/.. — extend it to also reject paths classified as material_source / fixture / config / story-framework-managed metadata (use the same classifier vocabulary). This is fail-fast UX layered on top of the classifier hard gate; both are required so a JSON-injected declared-artifacts.json entry is still caught by the classifier.
items.userSees: User runs `koala artifact_declare --storyId=B-8db9 --path=packages/main/src/core/store.ts --reason="..." --relatedIntent=CHK-001:happy:0` and sees an error: `artifact_declare: path packages/main/src/core/store.ts classifies as material_source_changes and cannot be declared as a generated artifact (declare only generated output paths, e.g. under tests/output/)`. Same rejection for fixture / config / koala-metadata paths.

happy.desc: artifact_declare with a path under tests/output/ (a generated output) succeeds and writes declared-artifacts.json

edge.desc: artifact_declare rejects a material source path / fixture path / config path / koala-metadata path with an explicit classification-named error

adversarial.desc: artifact_declare entry rejection uses the SAME classifier vocabulary (isMaterialSourcePath/isFixturePath) as dirty-worktree.ts — the two layers agree for a sample of material/fixture/config/output paths

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke: artifact_declare with a tests/output/ generated path succeeds and writes declared-artifacts.json

items.title: Block uncommitted declared artifacts at the DONE gate
items.context: declared_artifact_changes is blocking:false in dirty-gate-policy so an uncommitted declared artifact passes DONE but git merge will not carry it to main — it vanishes silently. Add a DONE gate row that, for each declared-artifacts.json entry, requires the path to be either committed-and-clean or absent; a dirty/untracked declared path blocks DONE with guidance to commit (deliverable) or remove (temp output). REVIEW/TEST keep the existing non-blocking behavior.
items.userSees: Running `koala story_advance --phase=DONE --storyId=B-8db9` while a declared artifact path is dirty/untracked shows DONE pre-check row `[✗] declared artifacts committed: 0/1 (uncommitted: tests/output/foo.json)` with blocking error and guidance: commit it if it is a deliverable, or remove it if it is a temp output. When the declared path is committed-and-clean the row reads `[✓] declared artifacts committed: 1/1`.

happy.desc: DONE pre-check declared-artifacts-committed row passes when every declared path is committed-and-clean

edge.desc: DONE pre-check row fails (blocking) when a declared artifact path is dirty or untracked, with commit/cleanup guidance
A declared artifact path that is absent (cleaned up) does not block DONE — row treats absent as acceptable

adversarial.desc: A git-ignored declared path blocks DONE with an explicit message that git-ignored paths must not be declared as deliverable artifacts (preMortem #2 anchor)
REVIEW/TEST gates keep treating declared_artifact_changes as non-blocking — the committed-check is DONE-only and does not change dirty-gate-policy table
